errors.text_span: Най-висок процент (31,1%) се наблюдава както за общини с население до 10 000 души, така и за градски райони
errors.evidence: The description claims that the 'highest percentage' (31.1%) is observed for urban areas ('градски райони'). However, within the 'type of area' group, the value for urban areas (31.1%) is the lower of the two, with rural areas being 68.9%. Furthermore, the overall highest percentage in the chart is 68.9%, not 31.1%.
